name: com.flexpa/registry
title: Flexpa health tools
description: Search health MCP servers, tools, and local models, with setup instructions for each.

tools.name: search_tools
tools.description: Find health tools and MCP servers by task or exact tool name. Local tool entries include input schemas for execute_tool. Indexed mcp_tool entries include the owning server, original toolName, and direct connection details. For schemaStatus=requires_connection, call tools/list on that server after connecting. Set include_locked=true to discover direct tools, servers requiring another connection, planned servers, and care services with no MCP server. Local_resource entries link to models that run locally; read their documentation before use. Use kind to narrow results.

query.description: Task or exact tool name to search for, for example "find a payer endpoint" or "directory.search_endpoints"

limit.description: Maximum number of matches to return, 1 to 20

include_locked.description: Also return entries that need another connection: direct MCP tools and servers, planned servers, and care services

kind.description: Only return entries of this kind

tools.name: execute_tool
tools.description: Invoke a local tool (kind=tool) found with search_tools using its input schema. Entries with kind=mcp_server or mcp_tool return guidance for the direct provider connection. Call indexed tools by their original toolName on that server after checking its current tools/list. A care_service entry has no MCP server and returns its website for the patient to use directly. Entries with kind=local_resource return repository and usage guidance; they cannot run through this server. Check tool annotations before execution; some tools can change or share data.

name.description: Exact entry name returned by search_tools, for example directory.search_endpoints

arguments.description: Arguments for the entry, matching the inputSchema search_tools returned for it. An object, or a JSON string of one
